hero.heading: Open Positions
hero.subheading: We are always looking for talented, passionate people to join our team.

jobs.title: Villa Attendant
jobs.summary: Maintain the immaculate presentation of our villas and ensure every guest arrives to a flawless, welcoming space.

responsibilities.text: Prepare and turn over villas to the highest standard before each guest arrival
Perform daily housekeeping services with discretion and attention to detail
Replenish amenities and report maintenance issues promptly
Assist with laundry operations and linen management

requirements.text: Previous housekeeping or villa attendant experience preferred
Strong attention to detail and pride in your work
Ability to work independently and as part of a team

jobs.title: Guest Experience Host
jobs.summary: Be the face of Stonetrail Villas — welcoming guests, anticipating their needs, and crafting memorable moments throughout their stay.

responsibilities.text: Greet and check in guests with warmth and professionalism
Coordinate arrival logistics, villa orientations, and departure arrangements
Respond to guest requests and resolve issues swiftly and graciously
Liaise with housekeeping, maintenance, and food & beverage teams
Curate personalised recommendations for dining, activities, and island experiences

requirements.text: Minimum 2 years in a guest-facing hospitality role
Calm under pressure with a genuine passion for service
Familiarity with property management systems is an asset

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician
jobs.summary: Keep our villas and grounds in exceptional condition — ensuring every system, fixture, and space meets the standard our guests expect.

responsibilities.text: Perform preventive and reactive maintenance across all villa units and common areas
Diagnose and repair electrical, plumbing, and HVAC issues
Maintain pool systems, landscaping equipment, and outdoor infrastructure
Document work orders and communicate status updates to management

requirements.text: Trade certification in electrical, plumbing, or general maintenance
Ability to work flexible hours including weekends
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach

speculative.heading: Don't see the right fit?
speculative.body: We welcome speculative applications from exceptional candidates. Send us your CV and a short note about what you bring.
